== Description ==
Greetings Farmers!

As a part of Hay Day’s 7th Birthday celebrations, seven YouTubers spent a special day on a farm in the countryside of Finland which was turned into a real Hay Day look-a-like farm with animals, the truck, the roadside shop and more!

Watch the video to see what they experienced and their thoughts about a complete Hay Day experience with all the bells and whistles!

More videos from the YouTuber's visit in Helsinki will be released soon, so remember to subscribe ►► https://supr.cl/SubHayDay
